Name: Poison Strike
Description: If unit initiates combat, deals damage to foe equal to 20% of their max HP after combat.

Name: Savage Blow
Description: If unit initiates combat, deals damage to foes within 2 spaces equal to 20% of their max HP after combat.

Name: Swordbreaker
Description: If unit’s HP is 50% or higher at start of combat and foe has a sword equipped, unit can follow up and foe cannot follow up.

Name: Lancebreaker
Description: If unit’s HP is 50% or higher at start of combat and foe has a lance equipped, unit can follow up and foe cannot follow up.

Name: Axebreaker
Description: If unit’s HP is 50% or higher at start of combat and foe has an axe equipped, unit can follow up and foe cannot follow up.

Name: Tomebreaker
Description: If unit’s HP is 50% or higher at start of combat and foe has a tome equipped, unit can follow up and foe cannot follow up.

Name: Bowbreaker
Description: If unit’s HP is 50% or higher at start of combat and foe has a bow equipped, unit can follow up and foe cannot follow up.

Name: Knifebreaker
Description: If unit’s HP is 50% or higher at start of combat and foe has a knife equipped, unit can follow up and foe cannot follow up.

Name: Artbreaker
Description: If unit’s HP is 50% or higher at start of combat and foe has an art equipped, unit can follow up and foe cannot follow up.

Name: Seal Strength
Description: If unit initiates combat, inflicts Str-6 on foe after combat. (Penalty shrinks by 1 each turn.)

Name: Seal Magic
Description: If unit initiates combat, inflicts Mag-6 on foe after combat. (Penalty shrinks by 1 each turn.)

Name: Seal Defense
Description: If unit initiates combat, inflicts Def-6 on foe after combat. (Penalty shrinks by 1 each turn.)

Name: Seal Speed
Description: If unit initiates combat, inflicts Spd-6 on foe after combat. (Penalty shrinks by 1 each turn.)

Name: Seal Resistance
Description: If unit initiates combat, inflicts Res-6 on foe after combat. (Penalty shrinks by 1 each turn.)

Name: Fierce Stance
Description: If foe initiates combat, grants Str+6 during combat.

Name: Steady Stance
Description: If foe initiates combat, grants Def+6 during combat.

Name: Darting Stance
Description: If foe initiates combat, grants Spd+6 during combat.

Name: Warding Stance
Description: If foe initiates combat, grants Res+6 during combat.

Name: Life and Death
Description: Unit deals +10 damage and takes +10 damage during combat.

Name: Triangle Adept
Description: When unit has weapon advantage, always follows up. When unit has disadvantage, foe always follows up.

Name: Cornered Beast
Description: If unit’s HP is 50% or less at start of combat, grants Crit+30 during combat.

Name: Self-Destruct
Description: If unit’s HP is 50% or less at the start of player phase, unit dies and deals 50% of its max HP to foes within 2 spaces.

Name: Duelist’s Blow
Description: When unit initiates combat, grants Avo+30 during combat.

Name: Darting Blow
Description: When unit initiates combat, grants Spd+5 during combat.

Name: Death Blow
Description: When unit initiates combat, grants Crit+20 during combat.

Name: Certain Blow
Description: When unit initiates combat, grants Hit+40 during combat.

Name: Armored Blow
Description: When unit initiates combat, unit takes 10 less physical damage during combat.

Name: Warding Blow
Description: When unit initiates combat, unit takes 20 less magical damage during combat.

Name: Spirit Strike
Description: When unit hits with an attack, inflicts -5 to foe’s engage meter.

Name: Unbreakable
Description: Prevents unit from being broken.

Name: Stalwart
Description: Reduces damage from effectiveness. [Might multiplier decreased from 3 to 2.]

Name: Unwavering
Description: Negates damage from effectiveness.

Name: Anchor
Description: Unit cannot be moved by skills, smash weapons, etc.

Name: Veteran
Description: Prevents unit from being broken. Reduces damage from effectiveness. [Might multiplier decreased from 3 to 2.]

Name: Veteran+
Description: Prevents unit from being broken. Negates damage from effectiveness.

Name: Void Curse
Description: Foes do not earn EXP fighting this unit.

Name: Fell Barrier
Description: A barrier created by Dark Emblems. Nullifies Effective: Fell Dragon and prevents 50% of damage to unit.

Name: Fell Barrier+
Description: A barrier created by Dark Emblems. Nullifies Effective: Fell Dragon and prevents 70% of damage to unit.

Name: Fell Barrier++
Description: A barrier created by Dark Emblems. Nullifies Effective: Fell Dragon and prevents 85% of damage to unit.

Name: Fell Barrier+++
Description: A barrier created by Dark Emblems. Nullifies Effective: Fell Dragon and prevents all damage to unit.

Name: Dark Barrier
Description: A barrier created by Dark Emblems. Prevents 20% of damage to unit.

Name: Dark Barrier+
Description: A barrier created by Dark Emblems. Prevents 40% of damage to unit.

Name: Dark Barrier++
Description: A barrier created by Dark Emblems. Prevents 60% of damage to unit.

Name: Dark Barrier+++
Description: A barrier created by Dark Emblems. Prevents 80% of damage to unit.

Name: Bond Breaker
Description: Makes enemy chain attack accuracy always 30%. Reduces damage taken. [Prevents 80% of damage.]
